title: Checkpoint
description: One `.msckpt` file; loadable by the CPU backend whichever backend wrote it (DESIGN.md § 6.2).

manifest_size.description: Header manifest size, in bytes, of the structured manifest (DESIGN.md § 6.2).

header_checksum.description: Header checksum/hash, blake3 over the header and manifest bytes with this field's own bytes counted as zero (DESIGN.md § 6.2); required, unlike the optional payload_hash.

file_size.description: Size of the `.msckpt` file in bytes; every offset and length is validated against it before mapping or allocating (DESIGN.md § 6.2).

alignment.description: The explicit alignment, in bytes, of every tensor offset in the payload (DESIGN.md § 6.2).

schema_hash.description: Compiler/model schema hash from the manifest. The checkpoint loads only into an artifact with an equal schema_hash and the same parameter paths, dtypes and shapes; anything else needs an explicit adapter (DESIGN.md § 6.2).

step.description: The step state at which the checkpoint was written (DESIGN.md § 6.2).

payload_hash.description: Verification hash of the payload, blake3 over the bytes from the payload start to the end of the file; format version 1 always writes it and a reader refuses a manifest without it (DESIGN.md § 6.2).

optimizer.description: Optimizer hyperparameters, kept so a resumed run continues with the same optimizer (DESIGN.md § 6.1, § 9 gate 7).

optimizer_slots.description: Optimizer state descriptors; empty for plain SGD (DESIGN.md § 6.2).

modelspec.artifact.ContentHash.title: ContentHash
modelspec.artifact.ContentHash.description: A blake3 digest under explicit serialization and version rules (DESIGN.md § 7), written as its 32 bytes in 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits (story:content-hash-schema-constrained).

modelspec.checkpoint.DType.title: DType
modelspec.checkpoint.DType.description: A tensor element type and its size in bytes; `f32` for every value, `i32` only for row ids an `embedding` reads, never a parameter or a checkpoint tensor (DESIGN.md § 2.2).

modelspec.checkpoint.Endianness.title: Endianness
modelspec.checkpoint.Endianness.description: The header's endian marker; the payload is little-endian, so a reader refuses Big (DESIGN.md § 6.2).

modelspec.checkpoint.OptimizerSlot.title: OptimizerSlot
modelspec.checkpoint.OptimizerSlot.description: One optimizer state tensor of one parameter, addressed in the payload like a parameter (DESIGN.md § 6.2). Its offset and length are bounded by the file size and aligned like a ParameterRecord's, and the pair (path, slot) is unique in a checkpoint; ESS states neither here.

dtype.description: Element type of the state tensor (DESIGN.md § 6.2 dtypes, § 6.2 never reinterpret tensor bytes).

shape.description: Shape of the state tensor (DESIGN.md § 6.2 shapes).

offset.description: Absolute byte offset of the tensor from the start of the file, a multiple of the checkpoint's alignment (DESIGN.md § 6.2).

length.description: Length in bytes, equal to the product of `shape` times `dtype.size_bytes`; offset + length <= the checkpoint's file_size (DESIGN.md § 6.2).

modelspec.checkpoint.ParameterPath.title: ParameterPath
modelspec.checkpoint.ParameterPath.description: A stable canonical parameter path such as `TinyMLP.fc1.weight` (DESIGN.md § 2.3).

modelspec.checkpoint.Shape.title: Shape
modelspec.checkpoint.Shape.description: A tensor shape; each dimension is a positive integer and rank 0 is a scalar (DESIGN.md § 2.2).

modelspec.training.LearningRateSchedule.title: LearningRateSchedule
modelspec.training.LearningRateSchedule.description: How the learning rate varies over steps, settled by coordinator decision D50 of 2026-10-25 under the operator's grant of 2026-10-24, after Devlin et al. 2019. With t counting steps from 1 and steps the run's total, the rate is lr*t/warmup_steps for t <= warmup_steps and lr*(steps-t)/(steps-warmup_steps) after, lr being OptimizerConfig.learning_rate; it starts above zero, peaks at lr at step warmup_steps and reaches zero at the last step. warmup_steps = 0 means no warmup; warmup_steps >= steps is refused (E-TYPE-024, or a run error when --steps shortens the run). The host computes each step's rate in Binary64 and rounds it once to Binary32 (DESIGN.md § 2.1, § 6).

modelspec.training.MuonConfig.title: MuonConfig
modelspec.training.MuonConfig.description: The hyperparameters of a Muon run besides those it shares with AdamW, settled by coordinator decision D67 of 2026-10-25 (DESIGN.md § 2.1). A matrix parameter no embedding reads takes the Muon update at OptimizerConfig.learning_rate; every other parameter takes AdamW at adam_learning_rate with the betas and epsilon of OptimizerConfig; both share its weight decay and schedule. The momentum buffer of each Muon parameter is not checkpointed, so a Muon run is neither checkpointed nor resumed.

momentum.description: The momentum of the Nesterov buffer, in [0, 1).

ns_steps.description: The Newton-Schulz steps that orthogonalize each update, in [1, 10].

adam_learning_rate.description: The peak learning rate of the parameters AdamW updates.

modelspec.training.OptimizerConfig.title: OptimizerConfig
modelspec.training.OptimizerConfig.description: Optimizer hyperparameters, recorded for reproducibility (DESIGN.md § 6.1). The AdamW fields are present exactly when kind is AdamW or Muon (Loshchilov and Hutter, decoupled weight decay), and muon exactly when kind is Muon; the AdamW first and second moments are a checkpoint's optimizer slots (DESIGN.md § 6.2).

learning_rate.description: The base learning rate; the peak rate when a schedule is present.

schedule.description: Present exactly when kind is AdamW or Muon, settled by coordinator decision D50 of 2026-10-25; SGD keeps its constant learning rate, as M0 has.

muon.description: Present exactly when kind is Muon, whose AdamW fields and schedule are present too (coordinator decision D67 of 2026-10-25).

x-ess-invariants: ((kind == Sgd and not (defined(weight_decay)) and not (defined(beta1)) and not (defined(beta2)) and not (defined(epsilon)) and not (defined(schedule)) and not (defined(muon))) or (kind == AdamW and defined(weight_decay) and defined(beta1) and defined(beta2) and defined(epsilon) and defined(schedule) and not (defined(muon))) or (kind == Muon and defined(weight_decay) and defined(beta1) and defined(beta2) and defined(epsilon) and defined(schedule) and defined(muon)))

modelspec.training.OptimizerKind.title: OptimizerKind
modelspec.training.OptimizerKind.description: SGD from M0; AdamW with decoupled weight decay and a warmup schedule from M3, written `adamw(lr = F, weight_decay = F, beta1 = F, beta2 = F, eps = F, warmup_steps = N)` (DESIGN.md § 1, § 2.1, § 11 iteration 4; epic:bert-from-scratch); Muon, orthogonalized momentum for the matrix parameters no embedding reads and AdamW for the others, written `muon(lr = F, momentum = F, weight_decay = F, ns_steps = N, warmup_steps = N, adam_lr = F, beta1 = F, beta2 = F, eps = F)` (DESIGN.md § 2.1, revision 0.51; story:muon-optimizer).

modelspec.training.RngState.title: RngState
modelspec.training.RngState.description: RNG algorithm, seed and counter position (DESIGN.md § 2.3, § 6.1, § 6.2).
